Description:
Add a unique piece of history to your space with this assortment of vintage teal glass insulators, once used to support overhead power lines. Each insulator in this set showcases distinct shapes, textures, and slightly different shades of teal and green, creating a captivating collection for display. Visible wear and patina reflect their authentic utility and age, enhancing their nostalgic character and appeal. One notable feature is a wooden base with a descriptive label, indicating these insulators were part of the Colorado Springs - Cripple Creek Toll Line, dated from 1910 to 1978. This historical detail adds an extra layer of interest, making the set especially attractive for collectors and history enthusiasts. Ideal for use as decorative accents on shelves, mantels, or desks, these insulators offer a charming way to incorporate industrial heritage into your home or office decor. This item is in used vintage condition and displays signs of wear consistent with age and previous use

284820019.description:
Mineral Specimen Lot - 8 Pieces
Agate, Petrified Wood, Calcite & Quartz Geodes
Natural Mineral Collection
A diverse 8-piece collection of natural mineral and geological display specimens featuring various formations, textures, and crystal structures. The assemblage includes polished cut display stones alongside hollow crystalline geode nodules, highlighting classic lapidary and natural rough presentations.
Items Included:
Polished Agate Half: Cut and face-polished specimen displaying concentric fortification banding in caramel and cream with a crystalline quartz core
Petrified Wood Block: Substantial cut specimen exhibiting rich reddish-brown, yellow, and amber banded grain patterns with raw textured backing
Calcite Cleavage Rhomb Specimen: Translucent block featuring prominent natural rhombohedral cleavage planes and matrix remnants
Quartz Geode Halves (5 pieces): Hollow natural geodes featuring interiors lined with sparkling crystalline quartz druzy cavities
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in sound structural condition. Polished faces on the agate and petrified wood show smooth finishes with minor handling contact. Rough matrix surfaces, natural fissures, crystal cavity inclusions, and cleavage breaks are inherent to the natural stone formation.

284257932.description:
Cross
Classic Century Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
1/20 12KT Gold Filled, Vintage with Original Box
The Cross Classic Century collection is a hallmark of American industrial design, celebrated for its slender silhouette and iconic conical top. Introduced to commemorate the company's centennial, this 12-karat gold-filled set represents the pinnacle of mid-20th-century professional writing instruments, combining a refined aesthetic with durable mechanical reliability.
1/20 12KT Gold Filled finish with linear pinstripe engraving on barrels
Twist-action mechanisms for ballpoint ink and mechanical lead advancement
Personalized engraving "DAVID #1" on upper barrel of both instruments
Complete with original presentation box and operating instructions booklet
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both pieces are personalized with "DAVID #1" near the clip. Gold-filled surfaces show light micro-scratching and minor age-appropriate patina. Mechanical components function smoothly as intended. The original presentation case is intact with minor external shelf wear and a clean green velvet-style interior.
